en.bdb: A wayfarer, on the way halted in an inn.
Then moved forward on the told path.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: naeh paraiee taat na chit rahasiaa|

en.bdb: He neither got envious with anyone nor did he get infatuated by any.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਏ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਵਿਵਾਹਿ ਨ ਹਸਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: mue na puchhai jaat vivaeh na hasiaa|

en.bdb: He neither asked the caste (identity) of any dying person nor he felt any delight witnessing the marriage ceremonies etc.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਸਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhaataa karai ju dhaat na bhukhaa tasiaa|

en.bdb: He happily accepted gifts of the Lord and never remained hungry or thirsty.
The lotus face of the gurmukh always remains in blossom due to continuous remembrance of the Lord.
